name: PSW submits and confirms their own availability
origin: Derived from existing care-v1 governance policy and implementation; acceptance specification awaits required review

actor.scope: active user in active tenant; own staff ID only

trigger: The PSW wants to declare a working time window.
start: No authenticated browser session; synthetic active PSW account and tenant exist in an isolated database.
end: After successful credential login, save and browser reload, the same active availability appears; its tenant, staff, times, audit and receipt match the request.
boundaries: This workflow ends at confirmed active availability. Withdrawal is a separate workflow.
Availability has no approval step. Leave request and independent leave approval are separate workflows.
One PSW actor is sufficient here. No new role grants or routes are introduced.
Current care authorization uses one exact role string; simultaneous multi-role accounts are not supported by this module.
preconditions: Use a fresh isolated database and synthetic credentials; never production data.
Use the real credential login handler; do not inject a pre-created browser session for full acceptance.
The PSW and tenant must be active; no existing successful availability is seeded.
Browser URLs include enable-semantics=true; API queries follow the registered API schema.

steps.name: Sign in
steps.expected: Valid synthetic credentials obtain a session through POST /v1/auth/login. Invalid credentials obtain no session; record the actual supported rejection response.

steps.name: Open Care
steps.expected: GET /v1/governance/care returns this PSW identity and only permitted tenant/self staffing data. Shared layout renders the staffing section.

steps.name: Enter own availability
steps.expected: Choose own staff ID, availability action, valid UTC window and nonempty synthetic note. Self-service staff options do not expose other staff.

steps.name: Save availability
steps.expected: UI sends action=availability through POST /v1/governance/care/staffing with an idempotency key. Response is 200 with new id and version=1. Transaction creates exactly one active window, one availability event and one matching request receipt.

steps.name: Reload and confirm
steps.expected: A full browser reload obtains the persisted row again. Staff, tenant, timestamps, active status and version=1 match the isolated database; exactly one event/receipt exists for that submission.

database_assertions.expectation: Returned UUID exists once, tenant_id=session tenant, staff_id=session user, kind=availability, status=active, version=1, created_by=session user; starts_at and ends_at equal transmitted instants.
One event for the returned window and version=1: same tenant, actor=session user, action=availability and exact synthetic note.
One receipt for actor and idempotency key; identical retry returns stored response without additional business rows.
A staffing_availability access entry is committed for the same tenant and actor with case_id null; a rolled-back mutation must not commit this access entry.

acceptance.requirement: Actual login form and handler establish the PSW session; invalid credentials establish none.
Perform all five steps with DB assertions and browser reload.
acceptance.current_evidence: only authenticated API persistence/read tested; browser and credential login missing

acceptance.requirement: Reject owner role, own PSW writing another staff member, foreign staff selection, forged tenant header and foreign withdrawal; no unauthorized business writes.
acceptance.current_evidence: scoped embedded PostgreSQL fixture; rerun before credit

acceptance.requirement: After a committed save with response lost, retry the same payload/key and verify one window/event/receipt. Changed payload with same key is rejected.
acceptance.current_evidence: same-key API replay tested; browser lost-response recovery missing

acceptance.requirement: Invalid dates reject without business writes; expired session rejects and UI clears protected content/returns to login.
acceptance.current_evidence: API rejection covered; full workflow UI checks missing

acceptance.requirement: Injected audit-write failure yields 503 with no window/event/receipt committed; retry after recovery succeeds exactly once.
acceptance.current_evidence: scoped embedded PostgreSQL fixture; native PostgreSQL rerun needed

acceptance.requirement: Verify shared layout, loading, empty, error, offline and retry states, EN/FR/ES and responsive controls using the isolated workflow.
acceptance.current_evidence: separate synthetic component checks exist; authenticated workflow missing

acceptance.requirement: Inputs and displayed values represent the intended instant. Existing datetime-local handling appends Z; verify UTC explicitly and resolve local-time expectations before broader acceptance.
Save source/spec-bound results and successful video URL using the governed UI/API evidence mechanism; pass all seven gates including required review.

existing_scoped_test.scope: Five sequential embedded PostgreSQL API test groups with pre-created sessions; no credential login, browser run or concurrency proof.
